case.pattern_description: A single device profile — SM-G935F Build/NRD90M | Android 7.0 | chrome 62.0 for android | 1920x1080 — reached through an anonymising proxy appears across 20 unrelated cardholders inside thirty days, marked new on each account it touches. No individual account shows a documented typology; the abuse is only visible as a hub in the card-device projection, which is why it has to be found by traversal rather than by scoring. It matches four confirmed-fraud closed cases (CC-2649, CC-2971, CC-2985, CC-3035) recorded as undocumented.

sar.narrative: Customer C13487, holder of card C13487-K1, is the subject of this report. Between 2016-11-22 and 2016-11-22, 1 transaction(s) totalling $74.96 were identified as unauthorised on that card, the earliest being transaction 3478561 and the transaction that triggered review being 3478561 for $74.96. The activity was conducted through the online channel in billing region 191.0. The transactions originated from device profile 'SM-G935F Build/NRD90M | Android 7.0 | chrome 62.0 for android | 1920x1080', which the issuer's identity record marks 'New' for this account, reached through an anonymous proxy. The activity matches no documented typology in the issuer's manual and is described in the accompanying case record. The same origin appears on 19 other card(s) belonging to unrelated customers within the same window, including C01289-K2, C01996-K2, C02910-K1, C02975-K1, C03676-K2, indicating a common actor across multiple cardholders rather than an isolated compromise. Closed investigation CC-2985 recorded confirmed fraud on comparable activity. The issuer assesses the probability of fraud at 0.97 on the evidence set out above. Total suspicious amount: $74.96.
